_doc: Drives the dashboard /shortlist page. Live cars matching `rule` show automatically; `pinned` VINs always show (as gone once they leave the feed); `excluded` VINs never show. `cars` holds per-VIN dealer listing links and notes; `dealers` holds per-dealer pricing behavior keyed by the feed's dealer_name.

Mercedes-Benz of Scarborough.behavior: Pricing looks software-driven, with odd-dollar prices: small ± moves around the 1st–4th of the month, rare large cuts (a GLS took one −$4,665 cut on Aug 7, then sat 2.5 months unchanged). Slow and unpredictable. (Hard data from 3 cars; the cadence is inferred.)

Park Place Motorcars Dallas.behavior: Thin data: Cars.com histories reset when cars are relisted. The only visible cut was −$637 (~1%) on day 41. Prices mostly end in 98; many CPO cars are ex-loaners. Expect small, infrequent moves.

Mercedes-Benz of Edison.behavior: Reprices the whole lot in sweeps every 4–10 days, mostly $500 nudges; deeper cuts Jun 25 and Oct 10–17. The group's verified out-the-door quotes average 0.4% above list. $899 doc fee, folded into advertised prices since Oct 16, so the feed now flips between $73,995 and $75,225.

Mercedes-Benz of Manhattan.behavior: Reprices the whole lot about every 2 weeks (Oct 3, Oct 17–18) in round $1,000/$2,000 steps; prices end in $X,900; no extra dealer fees. The first cut comes at the next sweep. Next sweep likely ~Oct 31 (inferred).

Mercedes-Benz of West Chester.behavior: Prices move BOTH ways on shared dates: Sep 30 cuts of $500–1,000, then Oct 13 increases of $500; another wagon was raised $3k within 4 days of listing. This looks like market-tracking software that raises prices when supply tightens, so waiting isn't guaranteed to pay. $490 doc fee.

Mercedes-Benz of Easton.behavior: Frequent car-by-car repricing every 1–13 days, $700–1,800 steps at odd prices (an S580 was cut 6 times in 6 weeks). Loaner-stock cars were moved into CPO retail on Oct 22. $398 doc + $50 filing fees.

Mercedes-Benz of Rochester.behavior: Lot-wide sweeps every ~5–9 days, $200–2,000 steps; first cut 5–11 days after listing; prices end in $X,095 or $X,595. $400 in fees.
